blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Police operatives in Isulan, Sultan Kudarat on Thursday were to search the home of a man suspected to be in possession of illegal drugs and firearms but he escaped before law enforcers reached his home in Barangay Lagandang around 3 p.m. READ: Gun confiscated from teenaged student in Sultan Kudarat Stil, law enforcers found a pistol and a grenade at the suspect’s house, said Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, Police Regional Office (PRO-12) director. Manibog said the search warrants were for suspected possession of illegal drugs and firearms against alias “Al,” 34, of Barangay Lagandang, Isulan town. A search […]...
